testCases.name: [FC-FEED-02] Home Feed Full Scroll → Back to First Card → Chat
testCases.description: Scroll the whole feed, return to the first card, and open its chat.

testCases.name: [FC-VOICE-01] Voice Input: Overlay → Send → Answer or Retry
testCases.description: Voice overlay listens and sends; heard speech gets an answer, silence offers Retry.

testCases.name: [FC-AUTH-02] Full Sign Up via Settings (Phone + OTP → Signed In)
testCases.description: Sign up from Settings with phone and OTP; Settings then shows Logout.

testCases.name: [FC-CHAT-02] Share AI Response via System Chooser
testCases.description: Share on an answer opens the Android share sheet.

testCases.name: [FC-PHOTO-02] Photo Question from Camera → AI Response
testCases.description: A camera photo sent as a question gets a complete answer.

testCases.name: [FC-PROF-01] Gender Card Shows for a New Account
testCases.description: A new account (no profile yet) sees the gender card with all its options.

testCases.name: [FC-NAV-01] Drawer: Change Language
testCases.description: Switching the language from the side menu really changes the app language (Hindi, then back to English).

testCases.name: [FC-NAV-02] Side Menu Home Returns From Help Screen
testCases.description: Side menu Home returns from the Help screen to home.

testCases.name: [FC-AUTH-03] Drawer → Sign Up: Phone-Input Screen
testCases.description: Side menu Sign up opens the phone-number screen.

testCases.name: [FC-AUTH-04] Settings → Sign Up: Phone-Input Screen
testCases.description: Settings Sign up opens the phone-number screen.

testCases.name: [FC-AUTH-05] Settings → Sign Up → Skip / Close Returns to Settings
testCases.description: Leaving sign-up from Settings without signing up returns to Settings.

testCases.name: [FC-SET-01] Settings: Toggle Display Mode (Day / Night / Auto)
testCases.description: Display mode cycles through Day, Night and Auto.

testCases.name: [FC-SET-02] Settings: Update Display Name
testCases.description: Editing the display name in Settings saves the new name.

testCases.name: [FC-HELP-01] Help: FAQ Opens and Expands Answers
testCases.description: A Help FAQ question opens the FAQ page at that question with its answer; other questions open and close on tap.

testCases.name: [FC-HELP-02] Help: Open Terms of Use
testCases.description: Help opens the Terms of Use.

testCases.name: [FC-HELP-03] Help: Open Privacy Policy
testCases.description: Help opens the Privacy Policy.

testCases.name: [FC-LOC-02] Weather: Skip Share Location → Continue Without Location → Answer
testCases.description: Skipping the share-location screen opens the chat, which asks for location; continuing without it gives a complete answer.

testCases.name: [FC-LEGAL-01] First-Launch: Open Terms of Use from Language Screen
testCases.description: Language screen's Terms of Use link opens the document.

testCases.name: [FC-LEGAL-02] First-Launch: Open Privacy Policy from Language Screen
testCases.description: Language screen's Privacy Policy link opens the document.

testCases.name: [FC-LEGAL-03] First-Launch: Open and Close Both Legal Documents
testCases.description: Each legal document closes back to the language screen.

testCases.name: [FC-LOC-03] Location Permission Persists After Grant
testCases.description: Location granted once is still used after the app restarts: weather opens the chat directly and answers without asking for location.

testCases.name: [FC-LOC-04] Location Denied → Continue Without Location → Answer
testCases.description: With location denied, weather still answers after Continue without location.

testCases.name: [FC-ERR-01] Returning User Cold Starts Offline → Cached Home
testCases.description: After reaching home online, a cold start in airplane mode opens the cached home, not the no-internet screen.

testCases.name: [FC-ERR-02] No-Internet Error: Retry Recovers to Language Screen
testCases.description: Try again after going back online recovers from the no-internet screen.

testCases.name: [FC-ERR-03] Chat Offline: Inline Error + Retry Recovers
testCases.description: Sending offline shows the chat error; Retry online gets the answer.

testCases.name: [FC-ERR-04] Chat History Offline: Error + Retry Loads History
testCases.description: Chat history offline shows the no-internet screen; Try again online loads the history.
